Problem Statement
Read the length and breadth of a rectangle and print its area, by calculating the area inside a function that takes two parameters.
Description
Read two integers length and breadth from input. Write a function rectangleArea that takes two integer parameters, multiplies them, and returns the area. Call this function from main() by passing the two values, and print the returned area.
Input Description
Two integers length and breadth separated by a space.
Output Description
Print the area of the rectangle.
